reviewer_role: Judge D — Offensive-Minded Security & Reliability Specialist

strengths.claim: Bulletproof SSRF blocking for all tool and key validation requests
strengths.evidence: src/lib/llm/provider.ts:isPrivateIp blocks 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, private RFC1918 subnets and DNS rebinding; 38/38 passing tests in tests/unit/ssrf.test.ts

strengths.claim: No server-side credential leakage or storage of BYOK secrets
strengths.evidence: BYOK keys passed strictly in request headers (x-stay-aai-key, x-stay-tts-key), never logged or stored in Supabase; ephemeral tokens expire in <=180s

strengths.claim: Hard medical and crisis safety gates
strengths.evidence: Zero dosage advice given; verified in tests/unit/safetyGates.test.ts; emergency UK routes (999, 111, 116 123, 85258) displayed instantly on crisis language

defects.repro: BYOK keys saved in browser localStorage are subject to physical device inspection if computer is unencrypted or shared
defects.proposed_fix: Warn user in Settings UI; provide single-tap 'Delete All Data' button to clear localStorage completely

missing_evidence: Independent external third-party penetration testing report
one_reason_to_reject: Browser storage of API keys requires trust in client environment endpoint security
one_compelling_reason_to_award: Strict defense-in-depth with zero hardcoded secrets, robust SSRF controls, strict CSP, and verified crisis boundaries
